name: Trujillo Alto (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: White field charged at the centre with the central part of the municipal shield, a blue shield with a white cross over green hills between palm trees.
history: Trujillo Alto is a town and municipality in the San Juan metropolitan area of Puerto Rico. The original flag, designed in 1982 by Pedro R. Meléndez, showed the whole shield on a white square; on 29 May 1998 the administration of Mayor Brunilda Soto Echevarría changed the design to show only the central part of the shield, the present form.
